Untrims all holes (interior trims) that do not touch surface borders

**Panel:** Comma → Surface · **Nickname:** `UH`

## Inputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Brep | `B` | Brep | Item |  | Trimmed surface or brep |
| Index | `I` | Integer | Item | `-1` | Index of inner loop to remove. -1 removes all inner loops. |

## Outputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Brep | `B` | Brep | Item | Surface with holes filled |
